name: TechInsights: Enflame S60 AI Accelerator Processor Floorplan Analysis
notes: INDEPENDENT TEARDOWN - the highest-quality evidence obtainable for Enflame. Identifies S60 as Enflame's THIRD-generation AI accelerator card, compute chiplet 'SCORPIO-AO' with 'ENFLAME SCORPIO-AO' die markings, manufactured by TSMC on N6NTO-HPC. Full node/BEOL/bitcell/critical-dimension/die-utilisation and manufacturing-cost analysis is paywalled behind the TechInsights platform, so no die area or cost figure is available. Confirms the part exists and ships, and pins the node - which is more than any other source establishes for any Enflame part.
